G4600.def: of uncertain derivation; the jaw-bone, i.e. (by implication) the cheek or side of the face:--cheek.

G4601.def: from «4602»; to keep silent (transitively or intransitively):--keep close (secret, silence), hold peace.

G4602.et: appr. from sizo (to hiss, i.e. hist or hush)
G4602.def: apparently from sizo (to hiss, i.e. hist or hush); silence:--silence. Compare «4623».

G4605.def: of Hebrew origin («06721»); Sidon (i.e. Tsidon), a place in Palestine:--Sidon.

G4606.def: from «4605»; a Sidonian, i.e. inhabitant of Sidon:--of Sidon.

G4607.def: of Latin origin; a dagger-man or assassin; a freebooter (Jewish fanatic outlawed by the Romans):--murderer. Compare «5406».

G4608.def: of Hebrew origin («07941»); an intoxicant, i.e. intensely fermented liquor:--strong drink.

G4610.def: of Latin origin; "silvan"; Silvanus, a Christian:--Silvanus. Compare «4609».

G4611.def: of Hebrew origin («07975»); Siloam (i.e. Shiloach), a pool of Jerusalem:--Siloam.

G4612.def: of Latin origin; a semicinctium or half-girding, i.e. narrow covering (apron):--apron.

G4613.def: of Hebrew origin («08095»); Simon (i.e. Shimon), the name of nine Israelites:--Simon. Compare «4826».

G4614.def: of Hebrew origin («05514»); Sina (i.e. Sinai), a mountain in Arabia:--Sina.

G4615.et: perhaps from sinomai (to hurt, i.e. sting)
G4615.def: perhaps from sinomai (to hurt, i.e. sting); mustard (the plant):--mustard.

G4616.def: of uncertain (perhaps foreign) origin; byssos, i.e. bleached linen (the cloth or a garment of it):--(fine) linen (cloth).

G4618.def: from a derivative of «4621»; grain-fed, i.e. fattened:--fatted.

G4619.def: from a derivative of «4621»; grained, i.e. fatted:--fatling.

G4620.def: from «4621» and «3358»; a grain-measure, i.e. (by implication) ration (allowance of food):--portion of meat.

G4621.et: plural irregular neuter sita {see'-tah}, of uncertain derivation
G4621.def: of uncertain derivation; grain, especially wheat:--corn, wheat.

G4622.def: of Hebrew origin («06726»); Sion (i.e. Tsijon), a hill of Jerusalem; figuratively, the Church (militant or triumphant):--Sion.

G4623.et: from siope (silence, i.e. a hush, properly, muteness, i.e. involuntary stillness, or inability to speak, and thus differing from (4602), which is rather a voluntary refusal or indisposition to speak, although the terms are often used synonymously)
G4623.def: from siope (silence, i.e. a hush; properly, muteness, i.e. involuntary stillness, or inability to speak; and thus differing from «4602», which is rather a voluntary refusal or indisposition to speak, although the terms are often used synonymously); to be dumb (but not deaf also, like 2974 properly); figuratively, to be calm (as quiet water):--dumb, (hold) peace.

G4624.def: from «4625»; to entrap, i.e. trip up (figuratively, stumble (transitively) or entice to sin, apostasy or displeasure):--(make to) offend.

G4625.def: ("scandal;" probably from a derivative of «2578»; a trap-stick (bent sapling), i.e. snare (figuratively, cause of displeasure or sin):--occasion to fall (of stumbling), offence, thing that offends, stumblingblock.

G4626.def: apparently a primary verb; to dig:--dig.

G4627.def: a "skiff" (as if dug out), or yawl (carried aboard a large vessel for landing):--boat.

G4628.et: apparently from skello (to parch, through the idea of leanness)
G4628.def: apparently from skello (to parch; through the idea of leanness); the leg (as lank):--leg.

G4629.et: from a derivative of skepas (a covering
G4629.def: from a derivative of skepas (a covering; perhaps akin to the base of «4649» through the idea of noticeableness); clothing:--raiment.

G4630.def: apparently of Latin origin; left-handed; Scevas (i.e. Scoevus), an Israelite:--Sceva.

G4632.def: of uncertain affinity; a vessel, implement, equipment or apparatus (literally or figuratively (specially, a wife as contributing to the usefulness of the husband)):--goods, sail, stuff, vessel.

G4633.def: apparently akin to «4632» and «4639»; a tent or cloth hut (literally or figuratively):--habitation, tabernacle.

G4634.def: from «4636» and «4078»; the Festival of Tabernacles (so called from the custom of erecting booths for temporary homes):--tabernacles.

G4635.def: from «4633» and «4160»; a manufacturer of tents:--tent-maker.

G4636.def: from «4633»; a hut or temporary residence, i.e. (figuratively) the human body (as the abode of the spirit):--tabernacle.

G4637.def: from «4636»; to tent or encamp, i.e. (figuratively) to occupy (as a mansion) or (specially), to reside (as God did in the Tabernacle of old, a symbol of protection and communion):-- dwell.

G4638.def: from «4637»; an encampment, i.e. (figuratively) the Temple (as God's residence), the body (as a tenement for the soul):-- tabernacle.

G4639.def: apparently a primary word; "shade" or a shadow (literally or figuratively (darkness of error or an adumbration)):-- shadow.

G4640.def: akin to skairo (to skip); to jump, i.e. sympathetically move (as the quickening of a fetus):--leap (for joy).

G4641.def: feminine of a compound of «4642» and «2588»; hard-heartedness, i.e. (specially), destitution of (spiritual) perception:--hardness of heart.

G4642.def: from the base of «4628»; dry, i.e. hard or tough (figuratively, harsh, severe):--fierce, hard.

G4645.def: from «4642»; to indurate, i.e. (figuratively) render stubborn:--harden.

G4646.def: from the base of «4628»; warped, i.e. winding; figuratively, perverse:--crooked, froward, untoward.

G4647.et: perhaps from the base of (4628) and (3700)
G4647.def: perhaps from the base of «4628» and «3700»; withered at the front, i.e. a point or prickle (figuratively, a bodily annoyance or disability):--thorn.

G4648.def: from «4649»; to take aim at (spy), i.e. (figuratively) regard:--consider, take heed, look at (on), mark. Compare «3700».

G4649.et: from skeptomai (to peer about ["skeptic"], perhaps akin to (4626) through the idea of concealment, cf (4629))
G4649.def: from skeptomai (to peer about ("skeptic"); perhaps akin to «4626» through the idea of concealment; compare «4629»); a watch (sentry or scout), i.e. (by implication) a goal:--mark.

G4650.et: apparently from the same as (4651) (through the idea of penetrating)
G4650.def: apparently from the same as «4651» (through the idea of penetrating); to dissipate, i.e. (figuratively) put to flight, waste, be liberal:--disperse abroad, scatter (abroad).

G4651.et: probably from an obsolete skerpo (perhaps strengthened from the base of (4649) and meaning to pierce)
G4651.def: probably from an obsolete skerpo (perhaps strengthened from the base of «4649» and meaning to pierce); a "scorpion" (from its sting):--scorpion.

G4652.def: from «4655»; opaque, i.e. (figuratively) benighted:--dark, full of darkness.

G4655.def: from the base of «4639»; shadiness, i.e. obscurity (literally or figuratively):--darkness.

G4656.def: from «4655»; to obscure or blind (literally or figuratively):--be full of darkness.

G4657.et: neuter of a presumed derivative of (1519) and (2965) and (906)
G4657.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «1519» and «2965» and «906»; what is thrown to the dogs, i.e. refuse (ordure):--dung.

G4658.def: probably of foreign origin; a Scythene or Scythian, i.e. (by implication) a savage:--Scythian.

G4659.et: from skuthros (sullen) and a derivative of (3700)
G4659.def: from skuthros (sullen) and a derivative of «3700»; angry-visaged, i.e. gloomy or affecting a mournful appearance:--of a sad countenance.

G4660.def: apparently a primary verb; to flay, i.e. (figuratively) to harass:--trouble(self).

G4661.def: neuter from «4660»; something stripped (as a hide), i.e. booty:--spoil.

G4662.def: from «4663» and a derivative of «977»; worm-eaten, i.e. diseased with maggots:--eaten of worms.

G4663.def: of uncertain derivation; a grub, maggot or earth-worm:--worm.

G4665.def: of uncertain derivation; the emerald or green gem so called:--emerald.

G4667.def: the same as «4666»; Smyrna, a place in Asia Minor:--Smyrna.

G4669.def: from «4667»; to tincture with myrrh, i.e. embitter (as a narcotic):--mingle with myrrh.

G4670.def: plural of Hebrew origin («05467»); Sodoma (i.e. Sedom), a place in Palestine:--Sodom.

G4671.def: dative case of «4771»; to thee:--thee, thine own, thou, thy.

G4672.def: of Hebrew origin («08010»); Solomon (i.e. Shelomoh), the son of David:--Solomon.

G4673.et: probably akin to the base of (4987)
G4673.def: probably akin to the base of «4987»; a funereal receptacle (urn, coffin), i.e. (by analogy) a bier:--bier.

G4675.def: genitive case of «4771»; of thee, thy:--X home, thee, thine (own), thou, thy.

G4676.def: of Latin origin; a sudarium (sweat-cloth), i.e. towel (for wiping the perspiration from the face, or binding the face of a corpse):--handkerchief, napkin.

G4677.def: of Hebrew origin (7799 feminine); lily; Susannah (i.e. Shoshannah), an Israelitess:--Susanna.

G4678.def: from «4680»; wisdom (higher or lower, worldly or spiritual):--wisdom.

G4679.def: from «4680»; to render wise; in a sinister acceptation, to form "sophisms", i.e. continue plausible error:--cunningly devised, make wise.

G4680.def: akin to saphes (clear); wise (in a most general application):--wise. Compare «5429».

G4681.def: probably of foreign origin; Spania, a region of Europe:--Spain.

G4682.et: prolongation from spairo (to grasp, apparently strengthened from (4685) through the idea of spasmodic contraction)
G4682.def: prolongation from spairo (to grasp; apparently strengthened from «4685» through the idea of spasmodic contraction); to mangle, i.e. convluse with epilepsy:--rend, tear.

G4683.et: from sparganon (a strip, from a derivative of the base of (4682) meaning to strap or wrap with strips)
G4683.def: from sparganon (a strip; from a derivative of the base of «4682» meaning to strap or wrap with strips); to swathe (an infant after the Oriental custom):--wrap in swaddling clothes.

G4684.def: from spatale (luxury); to be voluptuous:--live in pleasure, be wanton.

G4686.et: of immed. Latin origin, but ultimately a derivative of (138) in the sense of its cognate (1507)
G4686.def: of immediate Latin origin, but ultimately a derivative of «138» in the sense of its cognate «1507»; a coil (spira, "spire"), i.e. (figuratively) a mass of men (a Roman military cohort; also (by analogy) a squad of Levitical janitors):--band.

G4687.et: probably strengthened from (4685) (through the idea of extending)
G4687.def: probably strengthened from «4685» (through the idea of extending); to scatter, i.e. sow (literally or figuratively):--sow(- er), receive seed.

G4688.def: of Latin origin; a speculator, i.e. military scout (spy or (by extension) life-guardsman):--executioner.

G4689.def: apparently a primary verb; to pour out as a libation, i.e. (figuratively) to devote (one's life or blood, as a sacrifice) ("spend"):--(be ready to) be offered.

G4690.def: from «4687»; something sown, i.e. seed (including the male "sperm"); by implication, offspring; specially, a remnant (figuratively, as if kept over for planting):--issue, seed.

G4691.def: from «4690» and «3004»; a seed-picker (as the crow), i.e. (figuratively) a sponger, loafer (specially, a gossip or trifler in talk):--babbler.

G4692.def: probably strengthened from «4228»; to "speed" ("study"), i.e. urge on (diligently or earnestly); by implication, to await eagerly:--(make, with) haste unto.

G4693.et: from a presumed derivative of speos (a grotto)
G4693.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of speos (a grotto); a cavern; by implication, a hiding-place or resort:--cave, den.

G4694.def: of uncertain derivation; a ledge or reef of rock in the sea:--spot (by confusion with «4696»).

G4695.def: from «4696»; to stain or soil (literally or figuratively):--defile, spot.

G4696.def: of uncertain derivation; a stain or blemish, i.e. (figuratively) defect, disgrace:--spot.

G4697.def: middle voice from «4698»; to have the bowels yearn, i.e. (figuratively) feel sympathy, to pity:--have (be moved with) compassion.

G4698.def: probably strengthened from splen (the "spleen"); an intestine (plural); figuratively, pity or sympathy:--bowels, inward affection, + tender mercy.
